goal: Deliver the minimal Captain chat surface backed by a natural-language source Agent, so normal retail and PTR questions use allowed fresh WoW facts without requiring a WCL link or returning a fixed reply template.
userValue: A player can ask the Captain a WoW question naturally, start a clean topic, revisit an owner-isolated archive, and receive a useful current answer grounded in the sources that are actually available.
nonGoals: Do not collect Archon.gg pages without an approved API or written permission.
Do not turn private WCL logs, chat content, model output, API keys, or unverified claims into shared source memory.
Do not require normal build questions to provide a WCL, SimC, or profile link.
Do not represent source-reference trends as personal WCL conclusions, DPS rankings, or global BiS facts.

currentTruth.factOwner: news_backend owns the owner-isolated chat API, bounded context, source status, response validation, and persisted session/job state; chickenbro_agent owns narrow request classification and source-result shaping; Raider.IO and the official Warcraft Logs adapter remain the source owners.

mustChange: Render the Captain as a conversation with new-topic and archive actions instead of the old analysis dashboard.
Build bounded source context for natural answers from allowed Raider.IO and WCL facts, with no fixed answer template.
Keep failed model generation retryable without fabricating or persisting an assistant reply.
Run the decoupled Raider.IO source refresh on its own bounded systemd timer and install it through the repository deploy script.
Enable the cloud Codex executor only after its proxy route and an end-to-end chat smoke are verified.
mustNotChange: Keep guest and authenticated session ownership isolation intact.
Keep numeric and evidence-reference validation fail closed.
Keep SimC execution and personal WCL deep analysis on their existing worker paths.
Keep async deploy syncs disabled unless an explicit source-refresh unit owns the work.
riskUnknown: Community source freshness can still become partial or blocked and must remain visible as such.
Codex availability depends on the selected cloud proxy route and must remain separately observable from source freshness.
evidenceRequired: Targeted Python source-agent, API, database adapter, refresh, and deploy tests.
Typed API, legacy compatibility page, and UI architecture tests.
Candidate file-parity, service/timer, proxy, health, and end-to-end Codex chat smoke.
Explicit user acceptance of the visible Captain experience before closure.

ownership.factOwner: The backend validates source facts and response claims before persistence; the Taro/compatibility clients only render the typed result and preserve retry state.

engineeringHealth.reason: The change extends the large news_backend hotspot, so source shaping is isolated in chickenbro_agent, refresh work is isolated in a one-shot timer unit, and API/model failure paths are covered by targeted regression tests.

acceptanceEvidence: The Captain exposes only a conversation, new topic, and archive as its own top-level actions.
A normal WoW class question can produce a natural source-reference answer without a WCL link.
Model/schema failures return a retryable error and do not persist a fabricated assistant turn.
Cloud Codex completes a real owner-isolated chat request after proxy and backend restart.
The source refresh unit is active independently of the failed legacy community-template sync path.

decisionLog.decision: The user confirmed the Captain should feel like normal chat, with source/tool use and source-memory updates in the backend rather than explicit forms, fixed templates, or model-weight training.
The user accepted the visible Captain result and authorized closure with ‘OK，先收尾’.

harnessFindings.whatHappened: The selected cloud proxy upstream accepted CONNECT but reset the ChatGPT TLS handshake, leaving the Codex executor unavailable.
harnessFindings.impact: A dynamic source answer could still run through the alternate executor, but the configured Codex path was not usable.
harnessFindings.recommendedAction: Probe the selected upstream against ChatGPT before enabling Codex, retain source-route and executor smoke separately, and keep the feature flag reversible.
